def evolved_p96(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # x[i,j] = popcount(i XOR j): Hamming distance between row index i and col index j.
    # Position-based, no collective. N=16 -> indices 0..15 fit in 4 bits.
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device)
    ii = idx.view(N, 1)
    jj = idx.view(1, N)
    pc = None
    for b in range(4):
        bi = (ii // (2 ** b)) % 2
        bj = (jj // (2 ** b)) % 2
        term = (bi - bj).abs()
        pc = term if pc is None else pc + term
    return pc.to(x.dtype)

def evolved_p96(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # x[i,j] = popcount(i XOR j) = sum over bits of |bit_b(i) - bit_b(j)|.
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device)
    coeff = torch.tensor([1.0, 2.0, 4.0, 8.0], device=x.device).view(1, 1, 4)
    bi = (idx.view(N, 1, 1) // coeff) % 2
    bj = (idx.view(1, N, 1) // coeff) % 2
    pc = (bi - bj).abs().sum(-1)
    return pc.to(x.dtype)
